problem.title: Maximum Sum Submatrix No Larger Than K
problem.problemStatement: Given an N × M matrix of integers and an integer K, determine the maximum possible sum of any rectangular submatrix that does not exceed K.
problem.input: • First line contains N, M, and K. • Next N lines each contain M integers.
